title: WF03 ADP01/ES07 blocker: archive INSERT used SELECT * after tenant_id migration and silently skipped policy archival
summary: Resolved TC-ES-07-01 integration blocker by fixing archive SQL in src/event_store/store.zig to explicitly map events columns into events_archive after ADP-01 added tenant_id, and by including the boundary timestamp in keep_days/fallback cutoff comparisons for deterministic immediate archival when keep_days=0.

root_cause.details: migrations/027_adp01_event_store_tenant.sql added tenant_id to events_archive, but Store.archive still inserted with SELECT * , NOW(). Column order no longer aligned, so INSERT attempted invalid mapping and failed. Each archival SQL path swallowed the failure via catch continue, leaving TC-ES-07-01 with zero archived rows.

changes: Replaced all archive INSERT SELECT * statements with explicit events_archive column lists and explicit SELECT projections including tenant_id and NOW() AS archived_at.
Changed keep_days and fallback retention predicates from < to <= to include boundary timestamps and remove immediate-archive timing flakiness in ES-07 tests.

prevention: Do not use INSERT INTO ... SELECT * across tables that may diverge via additive migrations; always specify target columns and source projections explicitly.
In retention/archive paths, avoid silent catch continue on SQL execution failures for required archival operations; surface or track failures to prevent hidden data-path regressions.
When adding tenant columns to event-store tables, re-run ES-07 archival integration tests to verify schema-evolution compatibility.
